picks.title: Starcloud raises $250 million for orbital data centers as launch options dry up
picks.why_it_matters: A $250M raise for space infrastructure signals strong investor appetite for frontier compute solutions, and the 'launch options drying up' angle suggests emerging scarcity dynamics that could create opportunities for early-stage launch and space logistics startups.

picks.title: How AI accounting startup Rillet raised $100M and became a unicorn in 48 hours
picks.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that AI-native vertical SaaS replacing legacy back-office software can still command premium valuations and intense investor competition—a signal to look for similar plays in other unsexy enterprise categories.

picks.title: The DOJ is investigating a16z. What does this mean for venture capital?
picks.why_it_matters: DOJ scrutiny of board seat practices at a top-tier firm could reshape governance norms across VC, potentially affecting how early-stage investors structure board involvement and manage portfolio conflicts.
